# Shaik Vahid Basha

> Product & business builder at IIT Madras ('27). Co-founder & Business Lead at SyncPro, creator of RailRaksha, and builder of practical operational software and applied AI workflows.

## Selected Work
- [SyncPro](https://vahidbasha.me/work/syncpro): B2B SaaS construction schedule intelligence & field reconciliation workspace incubated at Nirmaan, IIT Madras. Live site: https://syncpro.org/
- [RailRaksha](https://vahidbasha.me/work/railraksha): Experimental offline-first Progressive Web App built with my father's field work on Indian Railways in mind. Live PWA: https://railraksha.tech/ | Repo: https://github.com/vahid-kanna/RailRaksha
- [Zamp AP Invoice Workbench](https://vahidbasha.me/work/zamp-ap): End-to-end Accounts Payable PDF-to-decision workflow prototype handling 2-way PO matching, variances, duplicate blocking, and safe escalation. Live demo: https://zamp.vahidbasha.me/ | Repo: https://github.com/vahid-kanna/complete-case-study-request-2
- [ZeroEka](https://vahidbasha.me/work/zeroeka): Product & Strategy internship (May-Jul 2026) covering AI document ingestion PRDs, PostHog onboarding telemetry, and B2B SaaS pricing.

## Engineering Lab
